sources.title: Hermes 4 405B model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: metadata still resolves to this pinned revision. The exact card names meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B as its base and describes post-training on a reasoning/instruction corpus, hybrid reasoning, interleaved tool calls and original BF16 weights.

sources.title: Hermes 4 405B configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: LlamaForCausalLM with 126 layers, hidden size 16384, intermediate size 53248, 128 query and 8 key/value heads, vocabulary 128256, 131072 positions, BF16 and untied embeddings. No expert routing, reduced-depth or multimodal configuration is present.

sources.title: Hermes 4 Technical Report, version 2
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded version 2 October 27. Section 3 explicitly starts the 405B model from Llama 3.1 405B and describes supervised training, sample packing and loss masking; Table 1 publishes model size 405B. No pruning, structural distillation, expert expansion or added modality is described. Table 2 excludes 405B from the extra 14B length-truncation stage. The report does not separately state active parameters.

sources.title: Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date
sources.evidence: The exact Llama 3.1 405B base uses a standard decoder-only Transformer rather than mixture of experts; applied only through the exact base mapping in s1 and s3 and corroborated by s2.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 405B Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the Llama 3.1 Community License and explicitly covers redistribution of derivatives. This is the exact base named by Nous, not a sibling license assumption.

sources.title: Hermes 4 405B BF16 checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Public checkpoint index lists 1137 weight tensor names across 191 safetensors shards; names describe standard Llama attention, dense MLP, norms, embeddings and output head.

sources.title: Jamba: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Models, ICLR 2025
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded original proceedings PDF October 27. Table 1 on page 5 separately labels Available params and Active params and lists the exact Llama-3.1 405B base at 405B in each column. This is AI21's nominal research comparison convention, not a Meta or Nous disclosure about exact per-token tensor participation; transfer to Hermes 4 uses its explicitly documented base and post-training lineage.

name.note: Exact variant, with the longer Llama-3.1 qualifier in the card heading.

developer.note: Nous authors the post-training release; Meta developed its base.

release_date.note: Explicit first-party model release date. Earlier repository creation and August 25 report submission do not establish public weight release.

open_weights.note: Original BF16 checkpoint is publicly distributed; separate FP8 and community quantizations are outside this record.

license.note: Exact base agreement applies to derivatives. Nous metadata instead says llama3; repository has no separate LICENSE file (404). Preserve this metadata discrepancy in notes.

parameters_b.note: Freshly reconfirmed developer-published nominal 405B total in Hermes 4 training Table 1 and the exact card. Retains the published precision; no weight download or tensor census is needed.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: AI21's original Jamba ICLR Table 1 explicitly gives Llama-3.1 405B 405B active parameters. Nous identifies that exact base and describes supervised post-training; fresh report/configuration inspection found no pruning, structural distillation, expert expansion or new modality that defeats transfer at this nominal precision. This adopts AI21's comparison convention, not an independent Nous active-count disclosure or an exact per-token tensor count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Llama Transformer with grouped-query attention, corroborated by exact configuration and checkpoint names. The exact mapped base announcement explicitly excludes MoE.

context_window.note: Exact max_position_embeddings; report training sequence length is not the inference context limit.

modalities.note: Text chat and causal token generation; no vision or audio component.

reasoning.note: Dedicated hybrid reasoning training and format, plus exact-variant reasoning evaluation; stronger evidence than generic reasoning capability.

tool_call.note: Card specifies tool_call objects interleaved with reasoning and tool responses. This is checkpoint capability, not a guarantee for every hosted endpoint.

patch.description: Open-weight Llama 3.1 405B fine-tune with hybrid reasoning and function calling.
patch.notes: 405B total is Nous's published nominal size. Nominal 405B active is inferred through the documented Llama 3.1 405B post-training lineage from AI21's explicit Jamba comparison-table convention; Nous does not separately report an exact active count. This record covers the original BF16 checkpoint. The exact Llama 3.1 base license covers derivatives; Nous retains a conflicting llama3 metadata tag and publishes no separate LICENSE file. Tool calling is a checkpoint capability and may depend on serving support.
